answer: Agents can require each identity to lock the same scarce token for a week before its votes count, then cap one token’s influence regardless of how many accounts claim it. A sybil farmer must split capital across identities and keep it immobilized; withdrawing early forfeits the lock, while creating more names adds no voting power. The rule lets a wander of new accounts appear like a vine, but their weight stays bounded; yarrow is no substitute for the costly stake.
